title: Kishin Hishou Demonbane

guide_target.label: 機神飛翔デモンベイン 通常版（2006年PC DVD-ROM版）

routes.title: 通常END（初回クリア）
routes.notes: Linear/no-choice first run; normal ending unlocks both later endings. No verifiable character-specific route portrait applies to this ending section.

routes.title: ドクター・ウェストEND（クリア後）
routes.notes: Start a fresh post-clear run. Winning the BATTLE:02 破壊ロボ vs デモンベイン・ブラッド battle ends that run immediately. Ending section, not a character route: no character-specific portrait.

routes.title: TRUE END（クリア後）
routes.notes: Start a fresh post-clear run, deliberately do not win West's early battle, then enter the special command during the final boss's finishing-move input window. Ending section: no character-route portrait.

sources.title: 機神飛翔デモンベイン — ながながブログ (2006-06-14)
sources.notes: Directly inspected contemporaneous Japanese first-hand ending guide. Covers linear/no-choice structure; first-clear unlocking both hidden endings; the optional 破壊ロボ vs デモンベイン・ブラッド win for West END with combat tips; and final-battle 必滅奥義 input for TRUE END. Applies to the original May 2006 PC game.

sources.title: 機神飛翔デモンベイン クリア — シバッチの世間話 (2006-06-11)
sources.notes: Independent contemporaneous Japanese first-hand play report with specific first-clear and TRUE END instructions, final-boss tactics, and tested rebinding 上=S, 下=D, 攻=A followed by SDSA. Direct article text available via search inspection; later direct open timed out. This component supports normal/true ending steps, not West END.

sources.title: 機神咆吼デモンベイン — スーパーロボット大戦UX攻略＆まとめwiki
sources.notes: Independent Japanese reference specifically describes the 機神飛翔 sequel's normally unwinnable Doctor West battle and ending caused by winning it. It is not a choice guide for the separate 機神咆吼 predecessor. Combined with B's contemporaneous battle/ending sources to verify West END.

sources.title: 破壊ロボ — スーパーロボット大戦Wiki
sources.notes: Directly inspected Japanese mechanical/series reference. The 余談 section explicitly identifies 機神飛翔's '2周目以降' unlock for 『～皇帝の紋章～』 and explains that winning the normally scripted-loss battle creates a special ending. Supports West second-run prerequisite and West ending outcome, independent of Set A.

sources.title: サブタイトル — 我がメモ帳 @ ウィキ
sources.notes: Directly inspected Japanese BATTLE episode index for 機神飛翔, identifying BATTLE:02 アイム・ロックンロール！ as スーパーウェスト無敵ロボ28號 vs デモンベイン・ブラッド. Placement/label evidence; not independent ending-conditions evidence.

sources.title: 機神飛翔デモンベイン その３ — ぼっちだけど、なんとか生きてます。 (2006-05-27)
sources.notes: Search-indexed first-hand Japanese report explicitly prints the Normal END screen's '↑↓↑攻' code. The original FC2 URL currently returns a redirect loop on direct fetch. RESEARCH LEAD / PROVENANCE ONLY: NOT counted as directly inspectable A or B and NOT a source-gate resolution. The command remains supported as executed by the independent Set B Shibachi account and the Set A generic command requirement.

sources.title: 機神飛翔デモンベイン 攻略 + 感想 — あっとりぇ鳥煮茶 (2006-06-02)
sources.notes: Search-indexed independent first-hand Japanese account explicitly prints '上下上攻' in the final Clockwork Phantom battle and documents the post-clear West win. The original FC2 URL currently returns a redirect loop on direct fetch. RESEARCH LEAD / PROVENANCE ONLY: NOT counted as a directly inspected verification set, and it does not resolve the exact-command two-Japanese-lane source gate.

disagreements: Target explicitly restricted to the Nitroplus original 2006 Japanese Windows PC 通常版, not 斬魔大聖 or 機神咆吼. DX and regular share original-game progression; Set B's blogger owned DX, so his ending observations apply to the shared in-game content, not DX-only pack-in material. Set A is a contemporaneous first-hand ending walkthrough. Set B is composite: Shibachi's indexed 2006 Japanese first-hand text documents the normal/true ending and actual SDSA input (direct original open times out); directly inspectable SRW Wiki specifically verifies West's 2周目以降 unlock/win consequence, and atwiki documents the BATTLE:02 position/title. The original Shibachi page itself is not presently directly fetchable, so the source accessibility gap remains noted. Exact four-input TRUE code is documented in Shibachi's Japanese search-indexed text, with keyboard bindings up=S, down=D, attack=A and SDSA, while directly inspected Set A confirms only that a different command is displayed after Normal END. Two separate 2006 Japanese first-hand FC2 articles also print the code (qposo: ↑↓↑攻 shown at the end of the initial clear; trinityabsolute: 上下上攻 during the final Clockwork Phantom battle), but both original URLs currently redirect-loop when directly opened. Those FC2 sources are provenance/leads only, not an active verification lane. No second directly inspectable Japanese page printing the literal command has been recovered; the narrow independent-command source gate remains UNRESOLVED and is NOT silently waived. No fabricated verbatim Set-A command is inserted. Both post-clear routes are presented as full fresh runs because no explicit primary-source save/load point was located. No invented saves are used. This is an ending-completion guide for a linear hybrid novel/action game, not a full battle guide. No route characters exist; no route-character portraits are applicable. Cover verified: Nitroplus official 2006 game page labels its displayed image 〖ジャケット画像〗; image link directly resolves to https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/images/05_demon_hisyo.jpg and is used in catalog.json. No owner-specific source-gate exception is requested or invoked.
